kcc_query_text_example: Small farmer with 3.8 acres in Harihar taluk, Davanagere; tail-end canal command with highly erratic releases; drilled private borewell 4 months ago but BESCOM electric line is 1.2 km away; applying for 60% subsidy for 5 HP standalone solar pump under PM-KUSUM Component B; need quotation format.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: BESCOM unenergized certificate; off-grid borewell with casing pipe installed

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Harihar taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: Bhadra Canal Command tail-end studies: Davanagere (Harihar/Honnali taluks) cereal cultivators experiencing canal water deficits and turning to off-grid solar pumping.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka solar energy logs: Farmers in canal ayacuts with unenergized borewells seeking off-grid solar pump assistance.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 1 (Solar Pump vs Krishi Bhagya & Hydrological Gating): Water source 'Borewell (Non-energized)' and status 'UNENERGIZED_OFF_GRID' strictly fire KUSUM_B_WATER_SOURCE_PRESENT and KUSUM_B_OFF_GRID_VERIFIED returning ELIGIBLE for PM-KUSUM Component B; canal land type disqualifies Krishi Bhagya (KRISHI_BHAGYA_NOT_DRYLAND) and Ganga Kalyana (GK_PARENT_NOT_DRYLAND); General category excludes corporation schemes.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate PM-KUSUM Component B qualification on off-grid unenergized borewell; verify strict exclusion of dryland schemes on canal-irrigated holding.
unresolved_dependencies: KREDL/MNRE state centralized vendor portal empanelment and beneficiary quota allocation for Davanagere district
